pregame.whyWatch: Division game for first place: the Browns lead the AFC North at 3-1, the Ravens are 3-1.
pregame.pressurePoint: Ravens run game vs Browns run defense. The Ravens are No. 10 of 32 in rush success rate (45%) and No. 6 in EPA a carry (0.01). The Browns rank No. 26 against the run (46%) and No. 22 by EPA a carry (-0.01). A clear edge, the kind that shapes a game plan. The Ravens should stay on schedule on the ground, which keeps third downs short and the clock moving. Watch the Ravens rushing attempts by halftime. North of 20 means the plan is working.
